problem.title: Minimum Refueling Stops
problem.problemStatement: A vehicle starts with an initial amount of fuel and must reach a destination. Fuel stations are located along the route, each providing a specific amount of fuel. Determine the minimum number of refueling stops required to reach the destination.
problem.input: • Distance to destination. • Initial fuel. • Number of fuel stations. • Position and fuel available at each station.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of refueling stops, or -1 if the destination cannot be reached.
